name: OBD2 Web Bluetooth Scanner & Gemini Performance Tuner
description: Industrial Web Bluetooth OBD2 dashboard and logger for ELM327 BLE dongles. Continuously polls standard PIDs and BMW B58 Mode 22 PIDs (Oil Temp, Oil Pressure, Ethanol content), provides high-frequency IndexedDB logging, full Driving Mode, and AI Drive Log Performance Tuner powered by Gemini.
